titolo: Master in Sport Design and Management
copy:
Sport today needs more than athletes. It needs professionals who can design, manage and develop the places where people play, meet and connect.
The Master in Sport Design and Management gives you a multidisciplinary perspective that combines design, infrastructure and management. Work on real projects, learn from industry leaders and build expertise that organisations are actively seeking.
Your future in sport can start here!
link_description: Learn more and kick-start your career

titolo: Master in Sport Design and Management
copy:
Sport has the power to reshape how people experience a city. From neighbourhood facilities to major venues, well-designed sports spaces can generate participation, connection and opportunity.
The Master in Sport Design and Management prepares you to contribute to projects that combine innovation, sustainability and social relevance.
If you're looking for a career with purpose, this is an opportunity to develop skills that matter 🚀

La formazione manageriale non si esaurisce con l’ultima lezione.
Con l’Executive MBA Part Time Roma entri nella community di POLIMI GSoM, business school tra le poche al mondo con accreditamento Triple Crown.
Dopo il Master avrai accesso per due anni a oltre 250 corsi intensivi per aggiornare continuamente le tue competenze e confrontarti con nuovi trend del management.
Perché il valore di un EMBA continua anche dopo la graduation.

titolo: Strategic Design for Innovation and Transformation
copy:
You don’t just study Strategic Design. You practise it.
This Master is built around real company projects, boot camps, and structured experimentation. You will work on how organisations shape innovation, not just why they need it.
Developed by POLIMI Graduate School of Management and POLI.design, the programme connects design methods with management tools in a practical learning environment.
Download the brochure to explore the structure, modules, and project work in detail.

Un percorso executive richiede impegno. Ma può essere costruito con il giusto supporto.
Per l’Executive MBA Part Time Roma sono ancora disponibili contributi, agevolazioni e soluzioni di sponsorizzazione aziendale per aiutarti a intraprendere il percorso.
Una formula pensata per professionisti che vogliono valorizzare la propria esperienza e acquisire strumenti per affrontare nuove responsabilità.
L’edizione di settembre sta per iniziare: ultimi posti disponibili.
👉 Scopri tutte le possibilità.
